description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to assist the Borrower in improving the assets and economic conditions of rural families in selected areas of the Borrower's Apurimac, Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junin, Huanuco and Pasco regions.

The project objective is to improve the assets and economic conditions of approximately 53,600 rural families in the selected areas of Apurimac, Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Junin, Huanuco, and Pasco, and strengthen government capacity to implement an integrated Sierra development strategy. The project has three components. Component 1 (Rural Businesses) will award demand-based financing for small subprojects proposed by groups of rural producers to build strategic productive alliances and increase market access and income. Component 2 (Community Development) will award demand-based financing for small subprojects proposed by communities and groups of families to increase basic agricultural and livestock production that will improve their socioeconomic and food security. Component 3 (Sierra Coordination, Project Management and Monitoring) will finance consulting and non-consulting services, goods, and operational overhead required to execute the project and monitor project performance and outcomes and support the national government's efforts to harmonize the entire portfolio of nationally and internationally financed projects and activities related to rural development in the Sierra.

comment.narrative:
Aggregate baseline: 678 kg/year per product.  Aggregated end of project value achieved: 956 kg/year per product
The indicator is reported for the totality of the Business Plans financed by Aliados II (795 plans). Data of volume and value of salesas collected for each subproject/BPS for the initial and final situation (without and with project situation). The volume of production for each subproject was converted to a standard volume measure to calculate the aggregate percentage increase in sales volume.

comment.narrative: The indicator is calculated via the application of a qualitative compliance survey to all subprojects financed by the project (1358), considering the following compliance criteria: (i) degree of participation of beneficiary families; ((ii) effectiveness of technical assistance providers; (iii) perspectives of own contracting of technical assistance services; (iv) perception of the increase in assets; (v) improvement of managerial and gender capacities. For each category, a rating is then added to establish whether theusiness has met its objectives in a four-rating scale from very successfully to unsuccessfully. The indicator reports the percentage of Plans laying on the categories of successful and very successful..
